lessonGoal: Students will read an informational text about major world industries, identify the main idea and supporting details, learn business and economy vocabulary, and write short explanatory responses about how different sectors shape the world of work.

warmUp.title: Warm-up
warmUp.instructions: Think about jobs and industries. Answer the warm-up questions below. There are no right or wrong answers.
questions: What kinds of jobs do people in your family or community do?
Which industry do you think is most important in everyday life? Why?
Would you rather work in technology, healthcare, energy, finance, or education? Explain your choice.

article.title: Big Industries of the World
article.source: Source: Adapted from teacher-provided classroom source image.
paragraphs: What makes the world of work go round? Every day, billions of people go to work, but they do very different jobs. To understand how all these jobs fit together, we divide businesses and jobs into groups called industry sectors. A sector is a group of companies and jobs that do similar things. For example, hospitals, doctors, and medicine companies are all part of the healthcare sector. Understanding these sectors helps us see how the global economy works.

At the highest level, the world economy is divided into three broad sectors. The first is the services sector. This sector includes healthcare, education, banking, and entertainment. It is the largest sector in the world, making up about 60% to 64% of global GDP (Gross Domestic Product). The second is the industrial or manufacturing sector, which includes factories, construction, and building things. This sector makes up about 30% of global GDP. The third is the agriculture or primary sector, which includes farming, fishing, and mining. This sector makes up only about 6% of global GDP.

Within these three broad categories, there are several major industry sectors that affect our daily lives. The consumer goods sector makes things we buy, like clothes, snacks, and toys. The technology sector creates software, apps, and devices like smartphones. The energy sector provides the oil, gas, and electricity that power our homes. The financial services sector includes banks and payment networks that manage money. Finally, the industrial goods sector produces machines and airplanes.

Some of these sectors are growing faster than others. For example, technology is growing quickly because of the rise of coding, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. The healthcare sector is also growing as people live longer and need more medical care. Another fast-growing sector is green energy, which focuses on wind, solar, and electric vehicles to replace fossil fuels. These growing industries create exciting new jobs for the future.
Ultimately, all of these industry sectors play a vital role in our daily lives. From the food we eat to the apps we use, we rely on the work of different industries every single day.

vocabularyInContext.title: Vocabulary in Context
vocabularyInContext.instructions: Read the key terms from the text and their definitions below.

items.definition: a group of businesses that produce similar goods or services
items.sentence: The technology industry creates software, apps, and smart devices.

items.definition: a specific part of a country's economy or a group of similar jobs
items.sentence: To understand how all these jobs fit together, we divide businesses and jobs into groups called industry sectors.

items.definition: Gross Domestic Product, or the total value of goods and services produced by a country in a year
items.sentence: It is the largest sector in the world, making up about 60% to 64% of global GDP (Gross Domestic Product).

items.definition: the part of the economy that provides services like healthcare, banking, and education rather than making physical products
items.sentence: The services sector includes healthcare, education, banking, and entertainment.

items.definition: the business of making products in large quantities in factories using machines
items.sentence: The second is the industrial or manufacturing sector, which includes factories, construction, and building things.

items.definition: the part of the economy that extracts raw materials from nature, such as farming, fishing, and mining
items.sentence: The third is the agriculture or primary sector, which includes farming, fishing, and mining.

items.definition: a person or organization that pays people to work for them
items.sentence: In many countries, technology, consumer goods, and healthcare are among the world's biggest employers.

items.definition: clean energy that comes from natural resources, such as solar power and wind, which does not harm the environment
items.sentence: Another fast-growing sector is green energy, which focuses on wind, solar, and electric vehicles to replace fossil fuels.

mainIdeaQuestion.title: Main Idea
mainIdeaQuestion.question: What is the main idea of the article?
options: Only technology companies are important in the world economy.
Different industry sectors do different kinds of work and play important roles in the global economy.
Farming is the largest and fastest-growing sector in the world.
People should only work in healthcare because it helps others.
mainIdeaQuestion.explanation: The article explains that many sectors, such as services, manufacturing, agriculture, technology, healthcare, finance, and energy, all play different roles in the global economy.

questions.question: What is an industry sector?
options: A type of factory that only makes toys.
A group of jobs and companies that do similar things.
A country with a very small economy.
A new form of green energy.
questions.explanation: The text defines a sector as a group of jobs and companies that do similar things, such as making toys, taking care of people, or building things.

questions.question: Which broad sector includes healthcare, education, banking, and entertainment?
options: The agriculture/primary sector
The industrial/manufacturing sector
The services sector
The technology sector
questions.explanation: The text states that the services sector includes healthcare, education, banking, and entertainment, making up about 60–64% of global GDP.

questions.question: What activities are included in the industrial/manufacturing sector?
options: Farming, fishing, and mining
Healthcare, education, and banking
Factories, machines, and construction
Software development and coding
questions.explanation: The text explains that the industrial/manufacturing sector includes factories, machines, and construction, making up around 30% of global GDP.

questions.question: Why are jobs in the healthcare sector growing quickly?
options: Because doctors want to buy more consumer goods.
Because people are living longer and need more caregivers, doctors, and nurses.
Because hospitals are using less technology.
Because healthcare is part of the primary sector.
questions.explanation: According to the article, as people live longer, more nurses, doctors, and caregivers are needed, leading to fast growth in this sector.

questions.question: Why is the green energy sector creating new jobs?
options: Because the world is moving away from fossil fuels and adopting wind, solar, and electric vehicles.
Because oil and gas companies are hiring more farmers.
Because people do not want to use electricity anymore.
Because green energy is a part of the stock market.
questions.explanation: The text explains that wind, solar, and electric vehicles are creating new jobs as the world moves away from fossil fuels.

questions.question: Why are technology and finance large parts of the stock market?
options: Because they do not have many workers.
Because they belong to the primary sector.
Because businesses in these sectors are highly valued.
Because they make up only 6% of global GDP.
questions.explanation: The text states that finance and technology are large parts of the stock market because businesses in these sectors are highly valued.

evidenceFromText.title: Evidence from the Text
evidenceFromText.instructions: Find and type the exact sentence from the article that supports each statement.

prompts.statement: Find one sentence or detail that explains what a sector is.
prompts.modelAnswer: A sector is a group of companies and jobs that do similar things.
prompts.compareTip: Your answer should quote or closely paraphrase the sentence that defines a sector as a group of companies and jobs that do similar things.

prompts.statement: Find one detail that shows healthcare is an important or growing industry.
prompts.modelAnswer: The healthcare sector is also growing as people live longer and need more medical care.
prompts.compareTip: Your answer should quote the detail explaining that the healthcare sector is growing as people live longer and need more medical care.

prompts.statement: Find one detail that explains why green energy is creating new jobs.
prompts.modelAnswer: Another fast-growing sector is green energy, which focuses on wind, solar, and electric vehicles to replace fossil fuels.
prompts.compareTip: Your answer should quote the detail about green energy focusing on wind, solar, and electric vehicles to replace fossil fuels.

languageFocus.title: Language Focus
languageFocus.explanation: When explaining complex topics or organizing informational text, writers use explanation and example language to clarify terms and show relationships. Key transition words and phrases include: 'such as', 'includes', 'for example', 'because', 'as a result', and 'plays a role in'. These help readers understand connections between sectors, products, and economic changes.
examples: The services sector includes healthcare, education, banking, and entertainment.
Within these three broad categories, there are several major industry sectors, such as consumer goods and technology.
For example, technology is growing quickly because of the rise of coding, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence.
Wind, solar, and electric vehicles are creating new jobs as the world moves away from fossil fuels.
Each sector plays a role in how the world works.
practice: Complete the sentence: The healthcare sector includes doctors, nurses, hospitals, and medicine companies. This sector is growing because __________.
Write one sentence using 'includes' and 'such as' to describe products in the consumer goods sector.
Write one sentence using 'as a result' to explain how technology impacts daily life.
Write one sentence using 'plays a role in' to describe how energy affects businesses.

writingPractice.title: Writing Practice
writingPractice.description: Write short responses to the questions below. Use complete sentences.

prompts.question: Which industry sector do you think affects your daily life the most? Why?
prompts.modelAnswer: I think the consumer goods sector affects my daily life the most. This is because I buy food, clothes, and snacks from companies in this sector every single day.
prompts.compareTip: Did your answer name a specific sector and explain how it affects your everyday life with clear reasons?

prompts.question: Why are technology jobs growing quickly around the world?
prompts.modelAnswer: Technology jobs are growing quickly around the world because companies need more people to build apps, write code, and handle cybersecurity. There is also a lot of growth in artificial intelligence.
prompts.compareTip: Did you explain that technology jobs are growing due to apps, coding, cybersecurity, or AI?

prompts.question: How does the healthcare sector help society?
prompts.modelAnswer: The healthcare sector helps society by taking care of sick people and providing medical treatments. It includes hospitals, doctors, nurses, and medicine companies that work together to keep people healthy.
prompts.compareTip: Did you mention that healthcare keeps people healthy, cures diseases, or includes doctors, nurses, and hospitals?

prompts.question: Why might green energy become more important in the future?
prompts.modelAnswer: Green energy might become more important because the world needs to move away from fossil fuels to stop pollution. Jobs in solar and wind energy will grow as we build more electric vehicles.
prompts.compareTip: Did you explain that green energy helps reduce fossil fuel usage and pollution while creating new jobs?

writingTask.title: Writing Task
writingTask.prompt: Write a short explanatory paragraph of 100–140 words answering this question: Which industry sector do you think will be most important in the future, and why?
checklist: Use at least one example from the article.
Use explanation language such as because, for example, as a result, includes, or plays a role in.
End with a clear concluding sentence.
writingTask.modelAnswer: I think the technology sector will be one of the most important industries in the future because it affects almost every part of modern life. This sector includes computers, apps, phones, software, cybersecurity, and AI. Many people use technology every day for school, work, shopping, communication, and entertainment. Also, technology jobs are growing quickly because companies need people who can solve digital problems and build new tools. For example, coding and AI are becoming useful in many different jobs. However, healthcare and green energy will also be important because people need safe lives and a cleaner planet. Overall, the technology sector will play a major role in the future economy.

selfCheck.title: Self-check
selfCheck.instructions: Before you submit, review your work.
items: I identified the main idea of the article.
I used details from the text.
I answered written questions in complete sentences.
I compared my answer with the model answer.

rubric.excellent: Clearly states a future-important sector, explains what it does, and provides two strong, distinct reasons.
rubric.developing: States a sector but the explanation of its importance or the reasons are slightly vague or repetitive.
rubric.beginning: Provides an incomplete opinion, fails to explain what the sector does, or gives no reasons.

rubric.excellent: Effectively integrates at least one clear, accurate example or detail from the article.
rubric.developing: Mentions a detail from the article but does not connect it clearly to the main argument.
rubric.beginning: Uses no evidence or details from the article.

rubric.excellent: Correctly and naturally uses several explanation words (because, includes, for example, as a result, plays a role in).
rubric.developing: Attempts to use explanation language but uses them incorrectly, resulting in awkward sentences.
rubric.beginning: Uses very little or no explanation language; sentences are disjointed.

rubric.excellent: Well-structured paragraph with a clear topic sentence, logical flow of points, and a strong concluding sentence.
rubric.developing: Has a general structure but lacks smooth transitions or has a weak opening/concluding sentence.
rubric.beginning: Lacks organization; ideas appear random and disconnected.

rubric.excellent: Demonstrates high grammatical control with very few spelling, punctuation, or word-use errors.
rubric.developing: Contains several grammatical, spelling, or punctuation errors, but meaning remains clear.
rubric.beginning: Errors in grammar and spelling make the paragraph difficult to understand.

teacherNotes: Pre-teach sector and industry because students may confuse them.
Use local examples such as hospitals, banks, delivery companies, schools, and phone apps.
Emphasize that a sector is a group of similar jobs or businesses.
Help students connect industries to future careers.
Encourage students to support written answers with details from the article.
For lower-level students, provide sentence frames.
For stronger students, ask them to compare two sectors.

teachingScript.actions: Begin by asking students what their family members do for work. Ask: 'Do they make products, help people, or work with computers?' Guide students to recognize that similar jobs are grouped together. Discuss warm-up questions 1 and 2, prompting students to explain why they chose certain industries.

Go through the Vocabulary in Context section. Introduce key terms: industry, sector, GDP, services sector, manufacturing, primary sector, employer, and green energy. Ask students to identify which sector their parents' jobs belong to. Check pronunciation of 'GDP' and 'manufacturing'.

Have students read the article 'Big Industries of the World' silently to grasp the main ideas. After reading, direct them to answer the Main Idea MCQ. Walk around to see if they understand the main point of the article.

teachingScript.phase: Second reading for detail and evidence
teachingScript.actions: Read the article aloud or have students read paragraphs in turn. Direct them to find and highlight the exact sentences needed for the Evidence from the Text section. Remind them to check their answers using the Check & Compare button to see if they correctly cited the evidence.

Focus on explanation and example language: 'such as', 'includes', 'for example', 'because', 'as a result', and 'plays a role in'. Write sentence frames on the board and have students practice completing them. Review their answers to the practice sentences.

Ask students to write short responses to the 4 Writing Practice questions. Emphasize using complete sentences. Walk around to help students who struggle with spelling or sentence structure. Encourage them to use the Check & Compare button to see the model answer.

Go through the checklist for the writing prompt. Have students draft their paragraph (100–140 words) about which sector will be most important in the future. Remind them to use at least one example from the text and use transition words. Have them check their word count.

Instruct students to check off the items on the Self-check list, enter their name and code, and click the submit button. Ensure all responses are saved locally or sent to the server. Congratulate them on completing the lesson.

mustKnowChunks.use: 앞선 주장에 대해 구체적인 사례를 들어 설명할 때 쓰는 필수 연결어입니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: I like outdoor activities. For example, I go hiking every weekend.

mustKnowChunks.use: 어떤 구성원이 큰 조직이나 범주에 포함되어 있음을 나타낼 때 씁니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: She is part of our project team.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: 복수형 명사들(hospitals, doctors, and medicine companies)이 주어로 나열되어 복수 동사 'are'가 쓰였습니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: healthcare sector는 '의료/보건 부문'으로 환자를 치료하고 건강을 지키는 비즈니스 전반을 일컫습니다.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 예를 들어서 병원, 진료하시는 의사 선생님, 아플 때 먹는 약을 만드는 제약 회사는 전부 사람들의 치료와 건강을 책임지니까 '의료 섹터'에 들어가는 거죠.

teachingTranscript.english: Using examples / helps clarify / the abstract definition / of a sector.
teachingTranscript.korean: 예시를 사용하는 것은 / 명확하게 해줍니다 / 추상적인 정의를 / 부문(sector)의.

sentences.original: Understanding these sectors helps us see how the global economy works.
sentences.chunkReading: Understanding these sectors / helps us see / how the global economy / works.
sentences.directKorean: 이러한 부문들을 이해하는 것은 / 돕는다 우리가 보도록 / 어떻게 세계 경제가 / 작동하는지.
sentences.naturalKorean: 이러한 부문들을 이해하는 것은 세계 경제가 어떻게 돌아가는지 파악하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 전 세계 국가들의 생산, 소비, 무역 활동이 얽혀 있는 경제 체제를 일컫습니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: Trade plays an important role in the global economy.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: 동명사 주어 'Understanding these sectors'는 3인칭 단수 취급하므로 동사 'helps'가 왔습니다. 'help + 목적어 + 동사원형(see)' 구조도 사용되었습니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: work는 여기서는 '작동하다, 굴러가다'라는 뜻으로 세계 경제 시스템이 유지되고 흘러가는 형태를 뜻합니다.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 이 각각의 섹터들을 제대로 알면, 전 세계 나라들이 서로 물건을 사고팔며 돈이 어떻게 돌고 도는지 큰 그림을 볼 수 있게 돼요.

teachingTranscript.english: Understanding the system / gives us / a better overview / of world economics.
teachingTranscript.korean: 시스템을 이해하는 것은 / 우리에게 줍니다 / 더 나은 개관을 / 세계 경제학의.

sentences.original: At the highest level, the world economy is divided into three broad sectors.
sentences.chunkReading: At the highest level, / the world economy / is divided / into three broad sectors.
sentences.directKorean: 가장 높은 수준에서, / 세계 경제는 / 나뉜다 / 세 개의 넓은(대략적인) 부문들로.
sentences.naturalKorean: 가장 큰 틀에서 볼 때, 세계 경제는 크게 세 가지 부문으로 나뉩니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 세부 사항을 보기 전에 가장 크고 넓은 분류 기준을 제시할 때 씁니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: At the highest level, science is divided into social and natural sciences.

mustKnowChunks.use: 수동태 표현으로 전체가 몇 개의 부분으로 분류되는 구조를 설명할 때 씁니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: The book is divided into ten chapters.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: 수동태 'is divided into'를 써서 세계 경제가 큰 세 부문으로 쪼개지는 대분류 상태를 묘사합니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: broad는 '넓은, 광범위한' 뜻으로 여기서는 아주 굵직굵직한 대분류 부문을 지칭합니다.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 아주 큰 돋보기로 넓게 들여다보면, 전 세계 모든 경제 활동은 딱 3가지의 거대한 덩어리로 나눌 수 있어요.

teachingTranscript.english: This introduces the macro-categories / of the global economic structure.
teachingTranscript.korean: 이것은 거시적 범주들을 도입합니다 / 글로벌 경제 구조의.

sentences.original: The first is the services sector.
sentences.chunkReading: The first / is / the services sector.
sentences.directKorean: 첫 번째는 / 이다 / 서비스 부문.
sentences.naturalKorean: 첫 번째는 서비스 부문입니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 의료, 교육, 유통 등 무형의 노동이나 가치를 제공하는 산업 영역을 말합니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: Many young people work in the services sector.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: 대명사 'The first'가 주어로 쓰여 세 가지 거대 부문 중 첫 번째를 가리킵니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: services는 복수형 명사를 형용사처럼 써서 물리적인 물건 대신 서비스를 다루는 분야임을 명확히 합니다.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 그 첫 번째 거대 분류는 바로 눈에 보이지 않는 편리함이나 도움을 주는 일을 뜻하는 '서비스 섹터'예요.

teachingTranscript.english: This is the first of the three / broad sectors.
teachingTranscript.korean: 이것은 세 거대 부문 중 / 첫 번째입니다.

sentences.original: This sector includes healthcare, education, banking, and entertainment.
sentences.chunkReading: This sector / includes / healthcare, education, / banking, / and entertainment.
sentences.directKorean: 이 부문은 / 포함한다 / 의료, 교육, / 은행 업무(금융), / 그리고 엔터테인먼트(대중문화)를.
sentences.naturalKorean: 이 부문에는 의료, 교육, 금융, 엔터테인먼트 등이 포함됩니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 앞 문장에서 언급한 서비스 부문을 지시형용사 'this'로 받아서 문장을 연결합니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: This sector has shown fast growth recently.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: 주어가 'This sector'로 3인칭 단수이므로 동사 'includes'에 's'가 붙었습니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: banking은 은행 업무나 금융을 뜻하고, entertainment는 영화, 음악, 방송 등 즐거움을 주는 콘텐츠 산업을 뜻합니다.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 병원(의료), 학교(교육), 은행(금융), 그리고 유튜브나 넷플릭스(엔터테인먼트) 같은 것들이 전부 이 서비스 섹터에 들어갑니다.

teachingTranscript.english: Notice the verb 'includes' / which lists specific examples / of the services sector.
teachingTranscript.korean: 'includes'라는 동사를 주목하세요 / 구체적인 예시들을 열거하는 / 서비스 부문의.

sentences.original: It is the largest sector in the world, making up about 60% to 64% of global GDP.
sentences.chunkReading: It / is / the largest sector / in the world, / making up / about 60% to 64% / of global GDP.
sentences.directKorean: 그것은 / 이다 / 가장 큰 부문 / 전 세계에서, / 차지하면서 / 약 60%에서 64%를 / 세계 GDP의.
sentences.naturalKorean: 서비스 부문은 전 세계에서 가장 큰 부문으로, 세계 GDP의 약 60~64%를 차지합니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 어떤 통계치나 비율, 비중을 차지한다고 설명할 때 자주 쓰이는 핵심 구동사입니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: Water makes up 70% of the human body.

mustKnowChunks.use: 대략적인 통계적 수치 범위를 제안할 때 'about'과 'A to B'를 결합합니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: The flight takes about 3 to 4 hours.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: , making up은 부대상황(동시동작이나 결과)을 나타내는 분사구문입니다. 원래 문장은 'and it makes up...'으로 풀어쓸 수 있습니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: global GDP는 '세계 국내총생산'으로 전 세계에서 1년 동안 만들어낸 모든 가치의 합을 뜻합니다.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 이 서비스 분야가 세상에서 가장 덩치가 커서, 전 세계 사람들이 벌어들이는 모든 돈과 가치의 절반이 훨씬 넘는 60~64%나 차지하고 있어요.

teachingTranscript.english: The participle 'making up' / introduces the statistical share / of this sector.
teachingTranscript.korean: 분사구문 'making up'은 / 통계적 점유율을 나타냅니다 / 이 부문의.

sentences.original: The second is the industrial or manufacturing sector, which includes factories, construction, and building things.
sentences.chunkReading: The second / is / the industrial or manufacturing sector, / which includes / factories, construction, / and building things.
sentences.directKorean: 두 번째는 / 이다 / 공업 또는 제조업 부문, / 포함하는 / 공장들, 건설, / 그리고 물건들을 만드는 것.
sentences.naturalKorean: 두 번째는 공장, 건설, 조립 및 제작을 포함하는 공업 또는 제조업 부문입니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 원자재를 가공하여 물리적인 제품이나 기계를 만들어내는 산업 분야입니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: The manufacturing sector is key to our country's exports.

mustKnowChunks.use: 기계, 건물, 소비재 등을 직접 제작하는 행위를 간단히 부르는 동명사구입니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: He has a passion for building things from wood.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: , which includes... 에서 'which'는 앞의 'the industrial or manufacturing sector'를 부연 설명하는 관계대명사의 계속적 용법입니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: construction is building structure like roads and buildings.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 두 번째 덩어리는 공장에서 무언가를 조립하고, 망치질해서 아파트나 다리를 짓는(건설) '제조업 및 공업 섹터'예요.

teachingTranscript.english: The non-restrictive relative clause / starting with 'which' / adds details about the industrial sector.
teachingTranscript.korean: 계속적 용법의 관계대명사절은 / 'which'로 시작하는 / 산업 부문에 대한 세부 정보를 더해줍니다.

sentences.original: This sector makes up about 30% of global GDP.
sentences.chunkReading: This sector / makes up / about 30% / of global GDP.
sentences.directKorean: 이 부문은 / 차지한다 / 약 30%를 / 세계 GDP의.
sentences.naturalKorean: 이 부문은 세계 GDP의 약 30%를 차지하고 있습니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 비율이나 구성비를 나타낼 때 수량 앞에 'about'을 써서 대략성을 나타냅니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: Sleep makes up about one-third of our lives.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: 앞 문장에서 설명한 'industrial or manufacturing sector'를 단수 주어 'This sector'로 이어받아 'makes up' 동사가 단수 처리되었습니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: 30% of global GDP is about one-third of the world production value.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 이 만드는 일(제조업)이 전 세계 전체 경제 크기의 30% 정도를 채우고 있어요. 꽤 큰 비중이죠?

teachingTranscript.english: This represents / the economic share / of the industrial sector.
teachingTranscript.korean: 이것은 나타냅니다 / 경제적 비중을 / 산업 부문의.

sentences.original: The third is the agriculture or primary sector, which includes farming, fishing, and mining.
sentences.chunkReading: The third / is / the agriculture or primary sector, / which includes / farming, fishing, / and mining.
sentences.directKorean: 세 번째는 / 이다 / 농업 또는 1차 부문, / 포함하는 / 농사짓기, 낚시(어업), / 그리고 광업(광산 업무)을.
sentences.naturalKorean: 세 번째는 농업, 어업, 광업을 포함하는 농업 또는 1차 산업 부문입니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 자연에서 원자재나 식량을 직접 얻는 가장 기본적인 농업, 어업, 임업 등을 말합니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: Developing nations often rely heavily on the primary sector.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: , which includes...는 마찬가지로 계속적 용법의 관계대명사로 농업/1차 산업 부문을 구체적으로 설명합니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: farming is agriculture, fishing is fishery, mining is extracting minerals.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 마지막 세 번째는 밭에서 작물을 키우고(농업), 바다에서 물고기를 잡고(어업), 땅을 파서 광물을 캐내는(광업) 아주 원초적이고 기초적인 '1차 산업 섹터'입니다.

teachingTranscript.english: The primary sector / is about extracting / natural resources.
teachingTranscript.korean: 1차 산업 부문은 / 추출하는 것에 관한 것입니다 / 자연 자원을.

sentences.original: This sector makes up only about 6% of global GDP.
sentences.chunkReading: This sector / makes up / only about 6% / of global GDP.
sentences.directKorean: 이 부문은 / 차지한다 / 오직 약 6%를 / 세계 GDP의.
sentences.naturalKorean: 이 부문이 세계 GDP에서 차지하는 비율은 약 6%에 불과합니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 수치가 예상이나 다른 대상에 비해 아주 작음을 강조하여 표현할 때 씁니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: Only about ten people showed up at the meeting.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: 부사 'only'를 사용해서 서비스업(60~64%)이나 제조업(30%)에 비해 비율이 매우 낮음을 강조합니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: 6% represents a very small portion but is essential for survival.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 농사나 어업은 전 세계 돈으로 치면 겨우 6%밖에 안 되지만, 우리가 매일 먹는 밥과 반찬을 주기 때문에 없어서는 안 될 가장 중요한 기초예요.

teachingTranscript.english: Although 6% seems small, / this sector is essential / because it provides food.
teachingTranscript.korean: 6%가 작아 보이지만, / 이 부문은 필수적입니다 / 식량을 제공하기 때문에.

sentences.original: Within these three broad categories, there are several major industry sectors that affect our daily lives.
sentences.chunkReading: Within these three broad categories, / there are / several major industry sectors / that affect / our daily lives.
sentences.directKorean: 이 세 가지 넓은 범주 안에서, / 있다 / 몇몇 주요 산업 부문들이 / 영향을 미치는 / 우리의 일상생활에.
sentences.naturalKorean: 이 세 가지 거대한 범주 안에는 우리의 일상생활에 직접적인 영향을 미치는 여러 주요 세부 산업 부문들이 존재합니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 어떤 요인이 우리의 하루하루 살아가는 모습에 밀접하게 연관되어 변화를 줄 때 씁니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: Weather apps affect our daily lives in many ways.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: that affect... 에서 주격 관계대명사 'that'의 선행사는 복수인 'several major industry sectors'이므로 동사 'affect'의 원형이 쓰였습니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: categories means classification groups.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 이 큰 세 서랍을 더 자세히 열어보면, 우리가 눈뜨고 잘 때까지 매일 접하는 아주 다양한 개별 산업 부문들이 들어 있어요.

teachingTranscript.english: Now we transition / from the macro-sectors / to specific, recognizable industries.
teachingTranscript.korean: 이제 우리는 전환합니다 / 거시 부문으로부터 / 구체적이고 알아볼 수 있는 산업들로.

sentences.original: The consumer goods sector makes things we buy, like clothes, snacks, and toys.
sentences.chunkReading: The consumer goods sector / makes / things / we buy, / like clothes, snacks, and toys.
sentences.directKorean: 소비재 부문은 / 만든다 / 물건들을 / 우리가 사는, / 옷, 과자, 그리고 장난감 같은.
sentences.naturalKorean: 소비재 부문은 옷, 과자, 장난감처럼 우리가 일상에서 구매하는 물건들을 만듭니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 일반 소비자들이 직접 돈을 주고 사서 쓰는 물건들을 통틀어 말합니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: Supermarkets are filled with various consumer goods.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: things와 we buy 사이에는 목적격 관계대명사 which 또는 that이 생략되어 있습니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: snacks and toys are typical consumer goods.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 과자나 옷, 장난감처럼 우리가 마트에서 내 돈 주고 사서 쓰는 모든 완제품을 만드는 곳을 '소비재 섹터'라고 해요.

teachingTranscript.english: The relative clause 'we buy' / modifies 'things' directly.
teachingTranscript.korean: 관계대명사절 'we buy'는 / 'things'를 직접 수식합니다.

sentences.original: The technology sector creates software, apps, and devices like smartphones.
sentences.chunkReading: The technology sector / creates / software, apps, / and devices / like smartphones.
sentences.directKorean: 기술 부문은 / 창조한다 / 소프트웨어, 앱들, / 그리고 기기들을 / 스마트폰 같은.
sentences.naturalKorean: 기술 부문은 소프트웨어, 애플리케이션, 그리고 스마트폰과 같은 전자 기기들을 만들어 냅니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 컴퓨터, 모바일 및 인공지능 관련 첨단 하드웨어와 소프트웨어를 개발하는 업계입니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: The technology sector attracts many creative engineers.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: like is a preposition meaning 'similar to'.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: devices are electronic equipment like phones and tablets.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 우리가 매일 쓰는 카카오톡, 게임 앱, 그리고 손에 들고 있는 스마트폰 같은 전자기기를 만드는 최첨단 산업이 바로 '테크 섹터'입니다.

teachingTranscript.english: This sector is very relatable / for Grade 9 students.
teachingTranscript.korean: 이 부문은 공감하기 쉽습니다 / 9학년 학생들에게.

sentences.original: The energy sector provides the oil, gas, and electricity that power our homes.
sentences.chunkReading: The energy sector / provides / the oil, gas, and electricity / that power / our homes.
sentences.directKorean: 에너지 부문은 / 제공한다 / 석유, 가스, 그리고 전기를 / 동력을 공급하는 / 우리의 집들에.
sentences.naturalKorean: 에너지 부문은 우리 가정에 전기를 공급하고 따뜻하게 해주는 석유, 가스, 전력을 제공합니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 발전소, 정유 회사 등 에너지를 생산하고 유통하는 산업 전반을 뜻합니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: The energy sector is focusing more on solar power.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: that power our homes에서 'that'은 주격 관계대명사이고, 'power'는 동사로 '~에 동력을 공급하다, 전기를 보내다'로 쓰였습니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: electricity is essential for lighting and devices.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 집에 불을 켜고, 보일러를 돌리고, 자동차에 기름을 넣는 모든 연료와 전기를 공급해 주는 원천이 '에너지 섹터'예요.

teachingTranscript.english: Note that 'power' / is used as a verb here, / meaning 'to supply with energy'.
teachingTranscript.korean: 주의하세요 'power'가 / 여기서는 동사로 쓰였음을, / '에너지를 공급하다'를 의미하는.

sentences.original: The financial services sector includes banks and payment networks that manage money.
sentences.chunkReading: The financial services sector / includes / banks and payment networks / that manage / money.
sentences.directKorean: 금융 서비스 부문은 / 포함한다 / 은행들과 결제 네트워크들을 / 관리하는 / 돈을.
sentences.naturalKorean: 금융 서비스 부문은 돈을 관리하고 송금해 주는 은행과 결제 네트워크(카드 회사 등)를 포함합니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 예금, 대출, 결제 등 자금을 다루는 서비스 업종을 통틀어 가리킵니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: Wall Street is famous for financial services.

mustKnowChunks.use: 신용카드 결제나 모바일 송금을 가능하게 해주는 가상 네트워크 시스템입니다.
mustKnowChunks.example: Visa and Mastercard run huge payment networks.

sentences.mustKnowGrammar: that manage money에서 'that'은 주격 관계대명사이며 선행사 'banks and payment networks'가 복수이므로 동사 'manage'가 쓰였습니다.
sentences.vocabularyUsageNote: manage means controlling and handling funds.
sentences.feynmanExplanation: 우리가 세뱃돈을 저금하는 은행, 그리고 부모님이 가게에서 물건을 사고 카드를 긁을 때 돈이 넘어가게 해주는 비자/체이스 같은 결제 시스템을 '금융 서비스 섹터'라고 불러요.

teachingTranscript.english: This industry / is key / for managing and moving capital.
teachingTranscript.korean: 이 산업은 / 중요합니다 / 자금을 관리하고 이동시키는 데.

sentences.original: Finally, the industrial goods sector produces machines and airplanes.
sentences.chunkReading: Finally, / the industrial goods sector / produces / machines and airplanes.
sentences.directKorean: 마지막으로, / 산업용 재화 부문은 / 생산한다 / 기계들과 비행기들을.
sentences.naturalKorean: 마지막으로, 산업재 부문은 비행기나 거대한 제조용 기계 등을 생산합니다.

sentences.original: For example, technology is growing quickly because of the rise of coding, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence.
sentences.chunkReading: For example, / technology / is growing quickly / because of / the rise of coding, / cybersecurity, / and artificial intelligence.
sentences.directKorean: 예를 들어, / 기술은 / 빠르게 성장하고 있다 / ~ 때문에 / 코딩의 부상, / 사이버 보안, / 그리고 인공지능.
sentences.naturalKorean: 예를 들어, 기술 부문은 코딩, 사이버 보안, 그리고 인공지능(AI)의 급격한 부상으로 인해 매우 빠르게 성장하고 있습니다.

mustKnowChunks.use: 전치사구로 뒤에 명사나 명사구가 와서 이유나 원인을 설명할 때 씁니다.

sentences.feynmanExplanation: 테크 섹터가 왜 이렇게 빨리 크냐면, 코딩을 배우는 사람들이 늘어나고, 컴퓨터 해킹을 막는 보안이 중요해지고, 챗GPT 같은 인공지능(AI)이 갑자기 나타나 유행하고 있기 때문이에요.

sentences.feynmanExplanation: 과학과 의학이 발달하면서 할머니, 할아버지들이 옛날보다 훨씬 더 오래 오래 건강하게 사시게 되었잖아요. 그러니까 병원도 더 자주 가게 되고, 돌봐줄 사람도 더 많이 필요해서 의료 섹터가 크는 거예요.

sentenceFrames: I think the __________ sector will be most important in the future because __________.
One reason it is important is that __________.
For example, the article mentions that __________.
As a result, more jobs will __________.
Overall, this sector plays a major role in __________.
usefulConnectors: plays a role in (~에서 역할을 한다)
paragraphOutline: Sentence 1 (Topic Sentence): State clearly which sector will be most important in the future.
Sentence 2 (Define/Explain): Explain what that sector does or includes.
Sentence 3-4 (First Reason + Evidence): Give the first reason, and support it with a detail/example from the article.
Sentence 5-6 (Second Reason + Detail): Give a second reason (e.g., job growth or environmental need).
Sentence 7 (Concluding Sentence): Summarize the impact of this sector on the future economy using 'Overall' or 'In conclusion'.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using 'because' as a preposition without 'of': *The technology sector is growing because the rise of AI.*
commonMistakes.correction: Use 'because of' before noun phrases: *The technology sector is growing because of the rise of AI.* or use 'because' with a clause: *...because AI is rising.*

commonMistakes.mistake: Using a verb directly after 'includes' without commas or wrong word form: *This sector includes coding and teach people.*
commonMistakes.correction: Keep parallel forms (usually gerunds or nouns): *This sector includes coding and teaching people.*

teacherCorrectionFocus: Check if the paragraph is within the 100–140 words range.
Ensure the student states their opinion clearly in the first sentence.
Confirm they provided at least two distinct reasons to support their opinion.
Verify they used at least one example or statistic from the article.
Look for explanation/example terms: because, includes, for example, as a result, plays a role in.
Check for a proper concluding sentence starting with 'Overall' or 'In conclusion'.
